name: כַּסְלֻחִים
summary: The Casluhim, a people descended from Mizraim, listed in both genealogies immediately after the Pathrusim. The etymology of the name is unknown.

evidence.note: The Casluhim follow the Pathrusim among the peoples whom Mizraim fathered.
The parallel genealogy again lists the Casluhim after the Pathrusim.

note: Moved from the former word entry `kkaselu7iym`. כסלח recorded the consonantal stem of the gentilic. Its etymology is unknown.
